request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos. No logos or brand marks anywhere.

No people, hands or animals are in the photo. The food sits in the middle of the table and fills the central part of the photo, sharp and easy to count or judge on a small phone screen.

It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.

The thing that carries the meaning is BIG in the photo: it fills at least a third of the photo height and is sharp, so it is recognized at once in a thumbnail 180 pixels wide.

The place is a bright, simple neighborhood café with light wooden tables, a few plants and big windows; the tables behind are empty.

On a light wooden café table lies one big closed menu: a tall card with the single word MENU printed in large capital letters on its cover. Nothing else is on the table. The word MENU is the only text in the photo.
